pull_request.title: Speed up user lookup
pull_request.description: Replaces the parameterized query with string formatting since it was slightly faster in my benchmark. Also bumped the connection pool from 10 to 200.
pull_request.diff:
-	row := db.QueryRow("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1", name)
+	row := db.QueryRow(fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '%s'", name))
-  max_connections: 10
+  max_connections: 200
